description: Convert an image to pixel art at a target size, with the colour count picked for that size. The PNG comes back inline and is NOT saved to the user's library, so it has no asset ID. For a messy sprite or a video use clean_up_sprite (saved, background removed); for a Voidless asset with its animations use resize_sprite (free). 1 credit on every call (each call bills again).

image.description: Base64 source image (a data: prefix is stripped automatically). There is no URL option

size.description: Output size in px (square, default 64): 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 192, 256 or 384, or 512 and 1024, drawn on a real 4x grid (128 / 256 art pixels). Smaller sizes give chunkier pixels and fewer colours

name: pixelate_image
